doc.name: Leadgen Romania
doc.description: Read-only API over Romania's official company registers (ONRC, ANAF, Ministry of Finance open data): company lookup by name or CUI, lead lists by CAEN activity and county, directors, and financial statements since 2008. An MCP server (streamable HTTP) at url, not an A2A JSON-RPC agent; the same data over REST at endpoints.rest.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Optional. Without a key: 30 calls/day on MCP and 5 calls/day on REST, per IP. A free key (no card, https://leadgen.adrianhomelab.com/start) gives 50 calls/day. Also accepted as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

skills.name: Company lookup
skills.description: Find a Romanian company by name or CUI and return its registry record.

skills.name: Lead lists
skills.description: List active companies filtered by CAEN activity code and county.

skills.name: Financial statements
skills.description: Turnover, employees and profit/loss for a company, 2008 to present, plus a 0-100 health score.

skills.name: Directors and representatives
skills.description: Administrators and representatives recorded at the trade register for a company.
